table.name: TLGNS_SAP_VENDOR
table.description: Contains SAP Vendor data (aka Forwarding Agent, in German: Lieferanten). In Logon, this is connected with Carriers. The only useful data right now is the name and Vendor No which is used later in the invoicing process.

column.name: SAP_VENDOR_ID
column.description: PK. Given by the Logon system.

column.name: SAP_ID
column.description: The (trimmed) ID used by SAP system. Received via the SAP interface, leading zeros are trimmed. This is a kind of foreign key into SAP (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / LIFNR, trimmed).

column.name: SAP_IFC_ID
column.description: The ID used by SAP system, exactly as received and also used for sending to other systems, i.e. including the leading zeros. Received via the SAP interface. (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / LIFNR, original).

column.name: UPDATE_BLOCKED_BY_HJID
column.description: Contains the hjid of the notification that blocks any further updates if this is the case or 'null' if not blocked. Non-enforced FK to ULGNSAP.VN_VENDORNOTIFICATION.

column.name: ACCOUNT_GROUP
column.description: Account group in SAP (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / KTOKK). No logic associated with it currently.

column.name: MARKED_FOR_DELETION
column.description: Deletion code in SAP (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / NODEL). 0=active, 1=deleted. Note that Logon normally has active_flag, with inversed logic. We stick to SAP standards in the tlgns_sap_... tables.

column.name: NAME1
column.description: Last Name/Company Name 1 from SAP (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / NAME1)

column.name: NAME2
column.description: First Name/Company Name 2 from SAP (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / NAME2)

column.name: COUNTRY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_country_bs. Country from SAP (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / LAND1).

column.name: POSTAL_CODE
column.description: Zip Code/Postal Code from SAP (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / PSTLZ)

column.name: CITY
column.description: City from SAP (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / ORT01)

column.name: LOCATION_DISTRICT
column.description: Location/District from SAP (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / ORT02). Not used currently.

column.name: REGION
column.description: Region (Canton in CH) from SAP (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / REGIO). There is currently no logic associated with it, therefore no refdata for regions (cantons) needed.

column.name: STREET
column.description: Street and house number from SAP (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / STRAS)

column.name: HOUSE_NUMBER
column.description: From Logon 2.0 EBM house number is received in field 'vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / STRAS' from SAP and stored in column STREET, so this field is null. Contains house number from SAP in older records (data received before Logon 2.0 EBM).

column.name: LANG_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_lang_bs. Language from SAP (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / SPRAS). 'Z1' from SAP is mapped to 'de'.

column.name: VAT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
column.description: VAT registration number from SAP (vendor_general_data (E1LFA1M) / STCEG)

column.name: VN_IS_COMM_CARRIER
column.description: Technical flag for easier filtering; is set if this VN has a PF to itself with function=SP (forwarding agent)

column.name: VN_IS_EXEC_CARRIER
column.description: Technical flag for easier filtering; is set if this VN has a PF to itself with function=ZC (subcontractor)

column.name: VN_IS_INTERNAL
column.description: Technical flag which is a requirement from CHE for reporting reasons; is set if this VN has account group ZGRP

column.name: TAX_NUMBER3
column.description: Tax Code Number 3. Vendor 'IA Number' Usage: If present, will be printed on the delivery note. No other usage in LOGON.

column.name: PHONE_NUMBER
column.description: Phone number. Usage: if present, will be printed on the delivery note. No other usage in LOGON.
